releaseNotes: v1.1.0 -- Multi-source architecture (standalone cameras, NVRs, Home Hubs); camera + doorbell component drivers with motion/AI attributes, PTZ (move, preset recall/save), spotlight, night vision, siren, and battery %; Sleep Status to distinguish a normal battery check-in gap from a real outage; in-app Tips page covering known device-specific connection quirks (battery-class devices and Reolink's E1 line both need a Home Hub/NVR or manual HTTP/HTTPS/ONVIF enablement). Confirmed working standalone against E1 Pro, Trackmix, and RL-1240A. Several PTZ/accessory commands and the motion/AI field names are pattern-based and not yet confirmed against every model -- see README for details.
author: jdthomas24

apps.name: Reolink Integration
apps.description: Manages Reolink sources (standalone cameras, NVRs, Home Hubs) and creates camera/doorbell child devices.
